description: Extract a segment between two times from an audio or video file and export a new clip. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: media_trim
title: Trim audio or video
